summary: Iteration 111 — Verified subscription blocking (trial/paid/grace), grace-request workflow, 7-day audit-log retention + Delete All, and product-order new required fields (email/address/pincode). Backend 8/8 tests passing after fixing a missing `db.grace_requests`/`db.audit_log` collection binding on the _DB wrapper (endpoints were 500ing). Frontend subscription-block modal verified end-to-end for both expired-trial ('Your Free Trial Has Ended') and expired-paid ('Subscription Expired') scenarios with WhatsApp + 2 email buttons visible. Salon admin settings page renders BrandingCard save button and AuditLogCard with the 7-day auto-delete note (Delete-all button conditionally rendered only when items exist — by design).

integration_issues.issue: Sonner success toast ('Salon Profile saved successfully ✦') was not observed via Playwright DOM polling after clicking [data-testid=settings-save-branding-btn]. Backend PUT /api/settings/branding returns 200 OK and BrandingCard.jsx line 43 has the correct success toast string, so this appears to be a Playwright/Sonner portal detection quirk rather than a functional bug. Manual verification recommended.

action_items: Main agent: verify manually that clicking 'Save profile' actually shows the sonner toast (code is correct — string matches spec; possibly a Playwright portal-detection artefact).
OPTIONAL: consider always showing the 'Delete all' button in AuditLogCard (currently only rendered when items.length > 0) so a fresh salon can still see the affordance.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (by testing agent): /app/backend/database.py — the `_DB` wrapper was missing bindings for `grace_requests` and `audit_log` collections. This caused `GET /api/billing/subscription-status`, `POST /api/billing/grace-request`, and `GET /api/settings/audit-log` etc. to raise AttributeError → 500. Added both as global (unscoped) collections since they are keyed by tenant_id at query time and grace_requests must be listable across tenants by super-admin.

auth._subscription_gate correctly differentiates trial (no grace, only explicit grace_until can extend) vs paid (60-day GRACE_DAYS window). Structured 403 detail payload {code, message, end_date} matches frontend SubscriptionBlockModal contract.
public_site.ProductOrderIn now hard-requires email/address/pincode (6-digit) via Pydantic Field/pattern — 422 on any missing field, verified.
product-orders receipt email is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — endpoint returns immediately even if Resend fails; acceptable per spec.

If retesting the frontend save-profile toast, use Playwright locator '[data-sonner-toast]' with polling immediately after click, or check page.locator('text=Salon Profile saved successfully'); note the toast lives inside a portal outside <body>'s regular tree.
rca of the issue: Grace/audit endpoints were introduced in this batch but the backend's `_DB` class in /app/backend/database.py was not extended with the new collections. Any request that used `db.grace_requests` or `db.audit_log` raised AttributeError, surfacing as HTTP 500 to the frontend. Fix: added both as unscoped attributes bound to `_raw_db.grace_requests` / `_raw_db.audit_log`. Verified by re-running pytest suite → 8/8 pass.
